name: Shadow Grave
summary: Newly freed Forsaken awaken in Shadow Grave, above Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Cradle of the Forsaken
sections.body: Shadow Grave sits on the rocky slope above Deathknell, a stone mausoleum where the newly freed Forsaken awaken. Once raised into the Scourge’s mindless service, the dead recover their free will in its vaults. Undertaker Mordo watches over them as they rise from stone slabs and take their first steps into a world that despises them. They follow the footpath down to Deathknell and pledge themselves to the Banshee Queen.

faq.q: What is the Shadow Grave used for?
faq.answer: Newly awakened Forsaken regain their free will in Shadow Grave, instead of remaining mindless Scourge thralls. From the crypt, they begin a second life serving Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Where is the Shadow Grave located?
faq.answer: Shadow Grave sits at the top of the graveyard slope above Deathknell, against Tirisfal Glades’ southern mountains. A dirt trail leads downhill from its entrance to Deathknell.

faq.q: Who oversees the newly awakened here?
faq.answer: Undertaker Mordo attends the newly awakened in the tomb. He judges whether they have recovered their minds and can serve the Forsaken cause.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, your journey begins on the crypt’s stone slabs, where you awaken to unlife and free will.
